about.text: At Design Tech, we develop practice-oriented, customized solutions that are precisely tailored to the individual needs and strategic goals of your company as well as the requirements of your market. With our decades of expertise in machine design and deep industry knowledge, we support you in sustainably securing and further expanding your market leadership.

contact.mainText: Let us shape your success together. Book your personal video call now and secure the decisive advantage.
contact.subText: So that our conversation is not just any exchange, but the starting signal for something extraordinary, we invite you to a brief online survey in advance. This way we don't meet in the fog, but exactly where your ideas, goals and challenges lie. Imagine what is possible - and expect more. We look forward to getting to know you.
